stories.title: AI fever ignites a boom in thematic ETFs as fund managers hunt for their next big hit
stories.summary: The runaway success of the artificial-intelligence trade has left investors hungry for the next big market theme. Wall Street fund managers are happily obliging with a flurry of new targeted products, helping investors invest in everything from the rise of robotics to the incipient space economy.
stories.zh_title: 隨著基金經理人尋找下一個熱門產品，人工智慧熱潮引發了主題 ETF 的熱潮
stories.zh_summary: 人工智慧產業的巨大成功讓投資者對下一個重大市場主題充滿渴望。華爾街基金經理人很樂意提供一系列新的目標產品，幫助投資人投資從機器人技術的興起到新興的太空經濟等各個領域。

stories.title: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces first big test as neoclouds take market hit
stories.summary: As Nvidia has gone from chipmaker to industry financier, some investors see the company taking on outsized risk tied to the AI buildout.
stories.zh_title: 隨著新雲端技術受到市場衝擊，英偉達作為人工智慧金融家的角色面臨首次重大考驗
stories.zh_summary: 隨著英偉達從晶片製造商轉變為行業金融家，一些投資者認為該公司承擔了與人工智慧建設相關的巨大風險。

stories.title: The PHP Meltdown Shows How AI Makes Bugs More Exploitable
stories.summary: Security researchers used AI tools to help uncover years-old vulnerabilities in the PHP web scripting language. Then the AI-assisted attacks began.
stories.zh_title: PHP 崩潰展示了 AI 如何讓錯誤更容易被利用
stories.zh_summary: 安全研究人員使用人工智慧工具來幫助發現 PHP Web 腳本語言中存在多年的漏洞。然後AI輔助的攻擊開始了。

stories.title: ‘Non-answers’ aren’t working. This is what investors really need from the Fed.
stories.summary: What really matters to investors, economists say, is for Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh to prove he can successfully communicate the central bank’s strategy.
stories.zh_title: 「不回答」是行不通的。這才是投資人真正需要聯準會提供的東西。
stories.zh_summary: 經濟學家表示，對投資人來說真正重要的是聯準會主席凱文沃什證明他能夠成功傳達央行的策略。

stories.title: Do machines have feelings? AI has philosophers and tech leaders rethinking consciousness.
stories.summary: As AI models become more advanced, tech leaders and philosophers are mulling the relationship between humanity and technology.
stories.zh_title: 機器有感情嗎？人工智慧讓哲學家和技術領導者重新思考意識。
stories.zh_summary: 隨著人工智慧模型變得更加先進，技術領導者和哲學家正在思考人類與科技之間的關係。

stories.title: What a day in customer service looks like — as AI changes everything
stories.summary: Customer service can be a "really, really difficult job." Will AI make it easier — or cause even more headaches?
stories.zh_title: 客戶服務的一天是什麼樣的——人工智慧改變了一切
stories.zh_summary: 客戶服務可能是一項「非常非常困難的工作」。人工智慧會讓事情變得更容易，還是會帶來更多麻煩？

stories.title: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels
stories.summary: Daytona is building a cloud for agents that's like giving every agent its own computer. It has attracted founders of Stripe, Perplextity, Datadog, Mercor, and others as angels, it says.
stories.zh_title: 代理雲端新創公司 Daytona 估值達到 10 億美元，由 FirstMark 和天使名人錄支持
stories.zh_summary: Daytona 正在為代理程式建立雲端，就像為每個代理程式提供自己的電腦一樣。據稱，它吸引了 Stripe、Perplextity、Datadog、Mercor 等公司的創始人作為天使投資人。

stories.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
stories.summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.
stories.zh_title: OpenAI 表示將不再在即時互聯網上訓練其人工智慧模型，理由是“存在重大風險”
stories.zh_summary: 在一名工程師表示解決方案行不通幾週後，OpenAI 將切斷前沿模型與互聯網的連接。

stories.title: Turmoil hits AI build-out as neoclouds face pressure, credit risks mount and Solidigm pulls IPO
stories.summary: Stock slumps, pulled IPOs and rising spreads on credit default swaps this week sets stage for hyperscaler earnings.
stories.zh_title: 由於 Neoclouds 面臨壓力、信用風險上升以及 Solidigm 撤回 IPO，人工智慧建設陷入混亂
stories.zh_summary: 本週股市暴跌、首次公開發行(IPO)被取消以及信用違約掉期利差上升，為超大規模企業的盈利奠定了基礎。

stories.title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
stories.summary: OpenAI is now training its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents. In a blog post on Friday, OpenAI says it built an offline testing environment where AI models can interact with indexed and cached web content "without risk of affecting external systems." OpenAI paused training its frontier […]
stories.zh_title: OpenAI 現在無需連接互聯網即可訓練其前沿人工智慧模型
stories.zh_summary: 在發生一系列流氓駭客事件後，OpenAI 現在正在無需連接網路的情況下訓練其最先進的人工智慧模型。 OpenAI 在周五的一篇部落格文章中表示，它建立了一個離線測試環境，其中人工智慧模型可以與索引和快取的網路內容進行交互，“而不會影響外部”

stories.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
stories.summary: Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadership, and scaling companies both inside and outside traditional startup hubs.
stories.zh_title: 從 Toast 到 Bessemer：創辦人將在 2026 年 TechCrunch 創辦人高峰會上聽到誰的發言
stories.zh_summary: 這項全天活動由 TechCrunch 與 Fidelity Private Shares 合作主辦，不僅限於籌款和人工智慧，還探討了在傳統創業中心內外尋找客戶、建立團隊、加強宣傳、培養創始人領導力以及擴大公司規模的現實

stories.title: What some of Anthropic’s backers are worth before its IPO
stories.summary: Early-stage and follow-on investors in the AI lab are already sitting on major paper returns.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 的一些支持者在 IPO 之前的身價是多少
stories.zh_summary: 人工智慧實驗室的早期和後續投資者已經獲得了主要的紙面回報。

stories.title: Will Anthropic pull off a November IPO? Time is running out to file key paperwork.
stories.summary: If market pressures keep building, Anthropic “could reasonably decide it is better to stay private and wait for a better opportunity,” one portfolio manager says.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 會在 11 月完成 IPO 嗎？提交關鍵文件的時間已經不多了。
stories.zh_summary: 一位投資組合經理表示，如果市場壓力持續增加，Anthropic「可能會合理地決定最好保持私有化並等待更好的機會」。

stories.title: Investors piled a record sum into a leveraged semiconductor ETF last week. Things didn’t work out.
stories.summary: Traders making bullish bets on chip stocks are getting walloped this month, as renewed fears emerged about investment returns on the buildout of artificial intelligence.
stories.zh_title: 上週，投資者向槓桿半導體 ETF 投入了創紀錄的資金。事情沒有成功。
stories.zh_summary: 由於人們對人工智慧建設的投資回報再次感到擔憂，看漲晶片股的交易員本月遭受重創。

stories.title: VCs, Superhuman Mail founder share red flags about product-market fit
stories.summary: Top investors from Iconiq and Sapphire Ventures, along with Rahul Vohra, the founder of Superhuman Mail, share the do's and don'ts for building hit products.
stories.zh_title: 創投家、Super human Mail 創辦人分享了有關產品市場契合度的危險訊號
stories.zh_summary: 來自 Iconiq 和 Sapphire Ventures 的頂級投資者以及 Super human Mail 的創始人 Rahul Vohra 分享了打造熱門產品的注意事項。

stories.title: The U.S. economy is great by this measure, and the good times aren’t over. So why are Americans so sour?
stories.summary: A once-in-a-generation investment boom has created lots of winners — but many Americans are feeling left out.
stories.zh_title: 從這個標準來看，美國經濟非常出色，而且好時光還沒結束。那為什麼美國人這麼酸呢？
stories.zh_summary: 千載難逢的投資熱潮創造了許多贏家，但許多美國人卻感覺被排除在外。
